```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

Inline comments:
In `@install/0000_00_cluster-version-operator_45_lightspeed-crd-proposals.yaml`:
- Around line 37-45: The CRD description for the Proposal resource contradicts
the actual spec: it currently claims "Proposal is cluster-scoped" while the CRD
sets scope: Namespaced; update the description text in the Proposal CRD so it
matches the spec (remove or replace "Proposal is cluster-scoped" with "Proposal
is namespaced" or equivalent), ensuring the human-readable description and the
scope: Namespaced field are consistent; locate the description block for the
Proposal resource and edit it accordingly.
- Around line 221-240: The schema currently allows an empty workflowRef.name,
permitting {workflowRef:{}} to pass admission; update the CRD schema for the
workflowRef object (the workflowRef.name property) to mark name as required and
constrain it (e.g., add "minLength: 1" or a non-empty pattern and ensure
"required: [\"name\"]" is present within the workflowRef properties) so that an
empty or missing name is rejected at admission rather than causing errors at
reconcile time.

In `@install/0000_00_cluster-version-operator_46_lightspeed-crd-agents.yaml`:
- Around line 98-115: Remove the misleading default and enforce non-empty names
for the cluster-scoped reference by deleting the `default: ""` under
`llmRef.properties.name` and adding `minLength: 1` to that property so
`spec.llmRef.name` cannot be empty; apply the same change pattern to any other
reference properties in this CRD that currently default to an empty string
(e.g., other `.properties.*.name` reference fields) to ensure controllers can
always resolve the referenced CRs.
- Around line 213-220: Add an x-kubernetes-validations CEL rule in the CRD
schema to enforce that outputFields and rawOutputSchema cannot both be set:
under the same schema object that defines outputFields and rawOutputSchema add
an x-kubernetes-validations entry with a rule expression that rejects objects
where both are present (e.g., use CEL to assert !(has(self.outputFields) &&
has(self.rawOutputSchema))) and a clear message; target the same schema block
that contains the outputFields and rawOutputSchema definitions so the API server
will validate mutual exclusivity at admission.

In `@install/0000_00_cluster-version-operator_47_lightspeed-crd-workflows.yaml`:
- Around line 7-10: The CRD manifest for the resource named
workflows.agentic.openshift.io (and the sibling Lightspeed CRDs) only has
feature-set and controller-gen annotations; add the standard install-manifest
annotations required by policy: include the cluster-profile annotations (e.g.
include.release.openshift.io/self-managed-high-availability and other
include.release.openshift.io/* profile keys used by adjacent install/ resources)
and add a kubernetes.io/description annotation that succinctly explains the
CRD’s purpose; keep the existing release.openshift.io/feature-set and
controller-gen.kubebuilder.io/version entries and apply the same annotation set
to the other Lightspeed CRD manifests added in this PR so they match adjacent
install/ resources.
- Around line 189-198: Current CEL validations only require agentRef when skip
is false but do not forbid agentRef when skip is true; add inverse rules that
reject agentRef when the corresponding step is skipped. Specifically, add three
new x-kubernetes-validations that assert: self.analysis.skip implies (not
has(self.analysis.agentRef) || self.analysis.agentRef.name == ''),
self.execution.skip implies (not has(self.execution.agentRef) ||
self.execution.agentRef.name == ''), and self.verification.skip implies (not
has(self.verification.agentRef) || self.verification.agentRef.name == ''), so
any spec with skip:true and a non-empty agentRef.name is rejected.

In `@test/cvo/proposal.go`:
- Around line 39-48: The test "should install light speed CRDs correctly" calls
util.IsTechPreviewNoUpgrade and thus must be marked as TechPreview; update the
Ginkgo It invocation to include the TechPreview label (e.g., add
Label("TechPreview") as an additional argument to the It call that contains the
loop and the util.IsTechPreviewNoUpgrade check) so the test is correctly
categorized and selectable.
```
